heading: § 9-001 Sidewalk shed permits.
text: Synthetic fixture text. A sidewalk shed may stay in place no longer than ninety days.

text: Synthetic fixture text. A sidewalk shed is a temporary structure.

heading: § 9-004 Drinking water tanks.
text: Synthetic fixture text. Building owners are required to inspect drinking water tanks each year.

text: Synthetic fixture text. Each tank of drinking water shall be cleaned.
